title: Theodia LLM manifest
description: Describes a Bible-specialized GGUF model distributed as GitHub Release assets. Read by the Theodia mobile app to download, verify, and load a model.

id.description: Globally unique, lowercase, stable across versions. Renaming this breaks every existing install.

displayName.description: Name shown in the app's model picker.

description.description: 1-2 sentence description for the picker UI.

releaseOwner.description: GitHub org/user that owns the release repo.

releaseRepo.description: GitHub repo name where the release lives.

releaseTag.description: Semver with a 'v' prefix, matching the git tag pushed for this release.

parts.description: Every part in strict concatenation order. Names match the asset names attached to the GitHub Release — GitHub flattens uploads, so the on-disk dist/<id>/path is NOT preserved. Bare 'part-NNN' is the common case.

totalSizeBytes.description: Sum of every part's byte size. Drives the download progress bar.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the concatenated file (same as the unsharded .gguf). Omit the field if not set; do not use an empty string.

sourceUrl.description: URL the original .gguf was downloaded from (Hugging Face model page).

sourceHash.description: Commit or revision hash pinned at the source repo (e.g. Hugging Face). Optional.
